    The separation step in cocycle form #

    Cocycles and coboundaries on a set D of objects (IsCocycleOn, IsCoboundaryOn) only see paths and arrows inside D. Let b ∈ D admit no arrow into D. If every cocycle on D is a coboundary on D, then two arrows into b whose sources are joined by a walk in D \ {b} lie in the same connected component of the poset of nonzero morphisms into b from D \ {b} (sepComp_of_coboundary): weight 1 on the arrows into b from one component is a cocycle on D. This is the separation property of Bautista–Larrión used in Fischbacher's Lemma 4.2, in the direction needed there.
